title: Edom Falls and Zion Is Delivered
summary_text: Obadiah's vision announces the LORD's judgment against Edom, whose pride has made it feel safe in the heights. Its allies will betray it, and its strength and wisdom will fail. The LORD condemns Edom's violence against Jacob, including gloating, looting, and cutting off fugitives during Judah's disaster. The coming Day of the LORD will return the nations' deeds upon them. Mount Zion will be holy and find deliverance, Jacob's people will reclaim land, and the kingdom will belong to the LORD.
key_points: The LORD will bring proud Edom down despite its high homes and trusted allies.
